requirements.evidence: Three full-depth bins placed: bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full, bin:0,1,0~hex-bin-full, bin:1,0,0~hex-bin-full on three connected cells (0,0,0; 0,1,0; 1,0,0)
Two keyhole hangers installed on central cell 0,0,0: accessory:0#0,0#1 (slot 1) and accessory:0#0,0#2 (slot 2) - hex-acc-keyhole

finish.summary: Built a 3-cell wall-hung spice rack (cells 0,0,0 - 0,1,0 - 1,0,0) with three full-depth bins, one per cell, and two keyhole hangers on the back of the central cell for secure wall mounting. Mesh clear; only LOOSE_BODY warning remains (joint bolts optional).

lines.label: M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
